messages:
maria_release: Quick heads-up — CI tokenization test failed in e2e/tokenizer-shard, seen in run #827. Looks like a token alignment assertion. Moving today's code cutoff from 23:00 UTC to 05:00 UTC to allow triage. If you need a critical cherry-pick, post linkage + one-line rationale by 02:30 UTC.

ajay_dev: Got it. I have a small driver patch on a feature branch that probably fixes a prefix-kv edge with quantized kernels. Will open a cherry-pick PR by 01:45 UTC.

sara_prod: Noted. Can we also pause the DB migration that's scheduled in the same window? Don't want customers hitting both deploy and schema change.

maria_release: @sara_prod yes, pause migration until I confirm new ship time. I'll coordinate with infra.

buildbot: CI: e2e/tokenizer-shard — failed (run #827)
```
AssertionError: token alignment mismatch at step 432
  File "/srv/infer/run_tests.py", line 217, in test_tokenizer
```
Logs: https://ci.internal/runs/827

ajay_dev: I'm reproducing locally with quantized-llama variant + prefix cache + kv-reuse. I have a plausible minimal fix: https://git.internal/pr/6742 (cherry-pickable). Tests pass locally for me; would like a quick pre-canary CI run.

tim_oncall: If we're sliding, tighten canary gates: start at 20% for 45m, then 60% for 30m. Add auto-fallback to previous model if token-error spike >0.5%.

chloe_pm: For #announcements copy, simple one-liner: "Ship window shifted ~6h due to CI test failure; ETA ~05:00 UTC. Will update with final ETA and canary plan." I'll hold until you paste the final sentence.

maria_release: Draft I plan to post:

"Heads-up: today's ship window delayed ~6 hours due to a failing tokenizer e2e. We're investigating and will confirm updated ETA and canary schedule here by 03:00 UTC. DB migration on hold until we post final timing."

sara_prod: +1. Add internal note about DB migration postponed.

ajay_dev: PR updated: added changelog line under build/ops: "fix(tokenizer): handle prefix-kv reuse with quantized kernels (cherry-pick)". Title includes `[target=0.12.0]`.

buildbot: CI: pre-canary run queued (job 829). ETA ~18m.

tim_oncall: On green, proceed: 20% for 45m, then 60% for 30m. I'll monitor metrics and hold ramp on any token-errors.

maria_release: Plan summary:
- 02:30 UTC: last-cherrypick cutoff
- 03:00 UTC: final status update here
- If CI green, canary start ~04:00 UTC per @tim_oncall; announcement to #announcements after canary kickoff.

Only ping me for critical blockers after 02:00 UTC. :thumbsup:
